meta.title: Economics regression tables
meta.tagline: Every regression table of an empirical economics article, transcribed by the Robustness-at-Scale pipeline, checked against its own contract, reviewed, released.
meta.description: The pipeline that reads each article and writes one file per regression table runs outside Metalens; this workflow is how its output enters a dataset: the new papers' files are uploaded into a run, the declared contract is re-checked on the stored values, every new column is reviewed, and a release is cut only when the review is done.

authors.affiliation: University of Basel; University of Copenhagen

steps.label: Regression tables
steps.help: one entry per estimated column, transcribed by the pipeline outside Metalens and uploaded here with the PDF; thirty new columns drawn at random, stratified by table, are reviewed before a release

steps.label: Contract check
steps.help: the declared fields, types and options re-checked on the values as stored, after corrections

steps.label: Number check
steps.help: every standard error names its coefficient, the parsed number is the printed one, stars agree with the level and the p-value, t with coefficient over se, the stated N with the printed N
